agent_explanation: No-controller two-circle collision creates energy. At step 8 bodies are separate with normal energy ~3125 J; at step 9 they are in contact (gap ~0.047) and energy is ~14969 J. The heavy body (m=6.72) accelerates 22.8->64.3 m/s while the light body only slows 46.6->40.5 m/s, so net kinetic energy grows ~4.8x with zero controller work. Setting body 0 restitution to 0 removes the gain. Likely cause: restitution impulse for unequal masses uses wrong effective mass / restitution combination (e.g. applies full e-separation impulse without momentum-consistent scaling, or adds positional-correction velocity), injecting energy when a light elastic body strikes a much heavier one at high relative speed with substepped contact (40-42 substeps).
